_comment: English locale for Word Chains. Keys (left) are fixed; translate only the values (right). Keep every {placeholder} verbatim, keep the square-bracket examples like '[apple]' and '[monkey]' intact (players wrap words in square brackets), and keep any single-letter tokens neutral.

_slots.{word}: A word (the current/starting word or a submitted word)
_slots.{start_letter}: The single letter the next word must start with
_slots.{length}: Required length of the next word (integer)
_slots.{count}: Number of characters in the submitted word (integer)

prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in the Word Chains Game.
Players take turns to provide valid English words that:
1. Start with the last letter of the previous word
2. Must be longer than the previous word
3. Cannot be a word that was previously used

If you provide an invalid word, repeat a word, or fail to follow the rules, you lose.
Please wrap your word in square brackets, e.g., '[apple]', '[monkey]', etc.
The starting word is [{word}].

board.next_word:
Next word must:
1. Start with '{start_letter}'
2. Be exactly {length} letters long

invalid.wrong_format: Player {player_id} did not provide a word in the valid format.
invalid.wrong_length: The word must be exactly {length} letters long. '{word}' has {count} characters.
invalid.not_a_word: '{word}' is not a valid English word.
invalid.already_used: The word '{word}' has already been used.
